verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.transliteration: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani ziz zikr

translations.text: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq

translations.text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas

translations.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab

translations.text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

verses.text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab

translations.text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
verses.transliteration: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad

translations.text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verses.transliteration: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq

translations.text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.transliteration: 'A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab

translations.text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.transliteration: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab

translations.text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

translations.text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

verses.text_uthmani: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.transliteration: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab

translations.text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Lootinw-wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu zul awtaad

translations.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

verses.text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.transliteration: Wa Samoodu wa qawmu Lootinw wa Ashaabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab

translations.text: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.transliteration: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab

translations.text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

translations.text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab

translations.text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab

translations.text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq

translations.text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab

translations.text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

verses.text_uthmani: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul Hikmata wa faslal khitaab

translations.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.transliteration: Wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab

translations.text: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat

translations.text: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab

translations.text: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.transliteration: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara Rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab

translations.text: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab

translations.text: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.text_uthmani: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Yaa Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi wa laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab

translations.text: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa ma khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fawi lul lillazeena kafaroo minan Naar

translations.text: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar

translations.text: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?

verses.text_uthmani: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee wa liyatazakkara ulul albaab

translations.text: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa wahabnaa li Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab

translations.text: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.transliteration: Iz 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy yis saafinaatul jiyaad

translations.text: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.transliteration: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab

translations.text: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

verses.text_uthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fatafiqa masham bissooqi wal a'naaq

translations.text: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana wa alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab

translations.text: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li ahadim mim ba'de inaka Antal Wahhab

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.transliteration: Fasakhkharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab

translations.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wash Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw wa ghawwaas

translations.text: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.transliteration: Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad

translations.text: And others bound together in shackles.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab

translations.text: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma-aab

translations.text: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu binus binw wa 'azaab

translations.text: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

verses.text_uthmani: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Urkud birijlika haaza mughtasalum baaridunw wa sharaab

translations.text: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam minna wa zikraa li ulil albaab

translations.text: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

verses.text_uthmani: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee wa laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab

translations.text: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.transliteration: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema wa Is-haaqa wa Ya'qooba ulil-aydee walabsaar

translations.text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi khaalisatin zikrad daar

translations.text: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar

translations.text: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a wa Zal-Kifli wa kullum minal akhyaar

translations.text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa zikr; wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma aab

translations.text: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

verses.text_uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.transliteration: Jannaati 'adnim mufat tahatal lahumul abwaab

translations.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw wa sharaab

translations.text: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab

translations.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Haaza maa too'odoona li Yawmil Hisaab

translations.text: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad

translations.text: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa; wa inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab

translations.text: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

verses.text_uthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fai'sal mihaad

translations.text: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa falyazooqoohu hameemunw wa ghassaaq

translations.text: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa aakharu min shak liheee azwaaj

translations.text: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum laa marhabam bihim; innahum saalun Naar

translations.text: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar

translations.text: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haaza fazidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar

translations.text: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaaloo ma lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar

translations.text: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Attakhaznaahum sikh riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar

translations.text: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar

translations.text: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw wa maa min ilaahim illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar

translations.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

verses.text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

translations.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem

translations.text: Say, "It is great news

verses.text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon

translations.text: From which you turn away.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bilmala il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon

translations.text: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

verses.text_uthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Iny-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa annnamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen

translations.text: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen

translations.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

translations.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

translations.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illaaa Iblees; istakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen

translations.text: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa man'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadai; astakbarta am kunta min 'aaleen

translations.text: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qaala ana khairum minah; khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen

translations.text: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem

translations.text: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen

translations.text: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

translations.text: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.transliteration: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

translations.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala fabi'izzatika la ughwiyannahum ajma'een

translations.text: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

translations.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.transliteration: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool

translations.text: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

verses.text_uthmani: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: La amla'annna Jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een

translations.text: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw wa maaa ana minal mutakallifeen

translations.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen

translations.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa lata'lamunna naba ahoo ba'da heen

translations.text: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
